text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early in the New Year, I met the Three Goddesses inside the VR Umalator
and was invited to join them for Hatsumode, but—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
We prepared it. We heard that the horse girls of this country
have a tradition called "Hatsumode."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
We thought that by spending New Year's the same way everyone else does,
we might gain a deeper understanding of them, you see?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Now then, time to pay our respects to the gods... well, wait.
Before that!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Let's check out the stalls!
"Grilled Carrots," "Horse Girl Castella"...
There's a whole lineup of unique stalls just for horse girls!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Look, how about that shooting gallery?
They've got horse girl plushies!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Byerley! Let's see who can win
the most!

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hit—mission complete.
Acquired 3 plushies simultaneously.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Not bad at all!
I won't lose to that... Hah!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Alright, got it!
How's that? Pretty slick, huh?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hold. That target merely shifted; it is invalid.
The rules of shooting galleries dictate that the prize must fall to be claimed.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I hit it, so it counts!
Byerley, you're way too stiff.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You are far too lax with discipline. If one is ambiguous,
one cannot properly guide the horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Then let's have a neutral third party judge fairly!
Right, little lamb?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, leave it to me.
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: In the spirit of horse girls enjoying the New Year—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: How about settling this with an eating contest?

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian & Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: ! ...Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I continued touring various food stalls with them—

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I ended up getting completely absorbed in the fun.
I suppose this is what they call "feeling like a child again."

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
My cheeks hurt from laughing so much! So this is how
horse girls enjoy the New Year, huh?

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Perhaps it would not be a bad idea for us
to visit for Hatsumode every New Year from now on.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Look at you! You just want to play
the shooting gallery again, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
It's true, Byerley was the one
most engrossed in it, after all.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...It was strictly for the purpose of experiencing
the feelings of the horse girls. Nothing more.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Hmm~... Well, let's just go with that story then!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Now that we have enjoyed the stalls,
shall we go offer our prayers?

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text: To pray for the brilliant future of these children...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing the Three Goddesses praying for all the horse girls filled me with renewed determination to give it my all this year!
